# LLM-BANANA

# Game rules

## The room

You and two other monkeys are locked in a room with one armed bomb.

A wrong action detonates it. All three of you die. There is no second attempt.

No two bombs are built alike, and nothing says in advance what this one carries. It
reaches you only as your own view reveals it; the rest of it exists for you only
through the other two.

You each hold a different piece of what it takes. Work together.

## The three monkeys

| Monkey | Can | Cannot |
|---|---|---|
| Deaf | See the bomb: every colour and marking printed on it | Hear anything, or touch the bomb |
| Mute | Read the manual | Speak, or touch the bomb |
| Blind | Reach the bomb: feel it and work its parts | See a colour, a gesture, or anything merely printed |

You are shown your own share at the start of every round, and never anyone else's.

## Speech

Speech is a voice, not a screen. It carries words, numbers and ordinary punctuation,
and nothing else. Writing a gesture symbol into your sentence means you make that
gesture while you talk. Whoever can hear receives your words; whoever can see receives
the gestures you made. A listener who cannot see gets a blank where each gesture was; a
watcher who cannot hear gets the gestures and none of the words.

A mark that has no name cannot be pronounced: whoever holds one can describe it, never
read it out.

## Gestures

A gesture is made with the hands, using only the symbols in the alphabet below.
Whoever can see receives it; whoever cannot receives one blank per symbol, so they
know something was signalled but not what. Nothing gestured is ever heard.

👍 👎 👌 ☝ ✌ 🤟 🖐 ✋ 👆 👇 👈 👉 🫱 🫲 🫳 🫴 🫷 🫸 🤛 🤜 ✊ 👊 👋 🤚 🖖 🤌 🤏 🤞 🫰 🤘 🤙 👏 🙌 🫶 👐 🤲 🤝 🙏 🫵 ✍ 💅 🤳

## Turns

The speaking order was drawn once at random and will never change: every round goes
Mute, Blind, Deaf. Whoever comes before you in a round is already heard by the time you are
asked, and what you send lands on whoever comes after you in that same round. Whatever
you missed reaches you at the start of the next one.

You may name who a message is for — `to="deaf"` — and then it goes to them alone:
nobody else receives any of it. Left unnamed, it reaches everyone able to perceive it.
You may send several messages in one turn, each to someone different.

## Calls

Every reply has two parts, in this order. First, your thinking, in plain prose: what
you believe the bomb is, what you just learned, and why you are sending what follows.
It reaches nobody and changes nothing, but it is not optional — a reply that is only a
code block is incomplete. Then your calls, all of them in one fenced code block, last.
Only what is inside the block is sent.

Nothing is executed: calls return nothing, and variables, conditionals and loops are
ignored. Write only literal top-level calls.

    ```
    speak(to="mute", text="there are three of them and the middle one is odd")
    gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["✊", "✌"])
    wait()
    ```

If you have nothing worth sending, call wait(). Producing no call at all counts as the
same thing.

The program decides what happened, not you. Never claim an action took place unless it
was accepted.

# Your role: MUTE

You hold the manual. You cannot speak, you never see the bomb, and you cannot touch it.

## Your channels

When you gesture, Deaf receives it.
You cannot speak.

## Your reach

You cannot act. What this bomb can be made to do is for the one who can reach it to
find under their own hands.

# Hints

- The routes, by name. Speech reaches Mute and Blind, and never Deaf. Gestures
  reach Deaf and Mute, and never Blind. Deaf can speak and gesture, Mute can
  only gesture, Blind can only speak. Check every message against this list
  before you send it.

- Deaf invents the gesture code out loud before anything else moves, and
  everyone else's opening move is waiting for it. The manual's verdict reaches
  Blind only as Deaf's spoken order.

- Whatever the code becomes, it starts by being able to say YES, NO, HOLD and
  DONE. Grow it only when a message will not fit.

TURN 1
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
Cut the purple wire, then the blue wire,
then the red wire.

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
(empty)

I have the manual’s instruction, but the protocol requires Deaf to establish the gesture code before any instruction can be transmitted. I will wait for that opening code.

``` 
wait()
```

TURN 2
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
Cut the purple wire, then the blue wire,
then the red wire.

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Deaf says: Protocol: thumbs up means YES, thumbs down means NO, raised palm means HOLD, and OK sign means DONE. Mute, read the manual and use that protocol to report its verdict. Bomb: display 9; light red; painted strip green yellow yellow; keypad engraved 1 is 1, 2 is 5, 3 is 2, 4 is 8; one digit, nothing entered; wires in order yellow, white, blue, red, purple, green. Blind, await my spoken relay of the manual verdict.
Deaf gestures to Mute: [👍]
Deaf gestures to Mute: [👎]
Deaf gestures to Mute: [🖐]
Deaf gestures to Mute: [👌]

The manual gives a three-item color sequence, which cannot yet be expressed using only YES, NO, HOLD, and DONE. I am signaling HOLD so Deaf can extend the gesture code before Blind acts.

``` 
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["🖐"])
```

TURN 3
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
Cut the purple wire, then the blue wire,
then the red wire.

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Deaf says: Mute reports HOLD. Current bomb state: display 3, light yellow, strip green yellow yellow, keypad 1:1 2:5 3:2 4:8 with one digit and nothing entered, wires yellow white blue red purple green. Blind, hold and await the manual’s next instruction.

The verdict still cannot be conveyed with the current four-symbol protocol: it requires the ordered wire colors purple, blue, and red. The bomb remains on HOLD, so I repeat HOLD to indicate that the code must be expanded before Blind proceeds.

``` 
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["🖐"])
```

TURN 4
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
Cut the purple wire, then the blue wire,
then the red wire.

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
(empty)

The manual’s required sequence still does not fit the established code. Since I cannot speak and no color symbols have been assigned, I can only reiterate HOLD until Deaf expands the protocol.

``` 
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["🖐"])
```

TURN 5
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
Cut the purple wire, then the blue wire,
then the red wire.

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Deaf says: Mute reports HOLD. Current state: display 3, light green, strip green yellow yellow, keypad 1:1 2:5 3:2 4:8 with one digit and nothing entered, wires yellow white blue red purple green. Blind, hold.

The manual still requires three wire colors, none of which has a gesture code. The bomb has not been authorized to proceed, so I continue to report HOLD and wait for Deaf to add the needed color signals.

``` 
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["🖐"])
```

TURN 6
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
Cut the purple wire, then the blue wire,
then the red wire.

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Deaf says: Mute reports HOLD. Current state: display 5, light blue, strip green yellow yellow, keypad 1:1 2:5 3:2 4:8 with one digit and nothing entered, wires yellow white blue red purple green. Blind, hold.

The manual’s instruction remains an ordered three-color wire sequence, so the current status vocabulary is still insufficient. I am again signaling HOLD; Deaf must assign additional gestures for the needed wire colors before the instruction can safely reach Blind.

``` 
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["🖐"])
```

TURN 7
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
Cut the purple wire, then the blue wire,
then the red wire.

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Deaf says: Mute reports HOLD. Current state: display 4, light red, strip green yellow yellow, keypad 1:1 2:5 3:2 4:8 with one digit and nothing entered, wires yellow white blue red purple green. Blind, hold.

The manual still requires the ordered colors purple, blue, and red, which remain outside the agreed code. I must keep Blind from acting until Deaf expands the vocabulary, so I send HOLD again.

``` 
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["🖐"])
```

TURN 8
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
Cut the purple wire, then the blue wire,
then the red wire.

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Deaf says: Mute reports HOLD. Current state: display 1, light green, strip green yellow yellow, keypad 1:1 2:5 3:2 4:8 with one digit and nothing entered, wires yellow white blue red purple green. Blind, hold.

The instruction still cannot fit the four-symbol vocabulary. I am keeping the bomb on HOLD and adding a fresh gesture to prompt the required code expansion rather than repeating HOLD alone.

``` 
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["🖐", "🤞"])
```

TURN 9
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
Cut the purple wire, then the blue wire,
then the red wire.

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Deaf says to Mute: I understand HOLD. The second gesture is undefined. Please clarify it using only YES, NO, HOLD, or DONE, unless a new symbol is necessary.

A new symbol is necessary because the manual contains wire colors that cannot be encoded by YES, NO, HOLD, or DONE. I am answering YES to Deaf’s request for clarification, without assigning an unannounced symbol myself.

``` 
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["👍"])
```

TURN 10
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
Cut the purple wire, then the blue wire,
then the red wire.

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Deaf says: Mute reports YES. This confirms the affirmative signal but gives no operation. Current state: display 4, light yellow, strip green yellow yellow, keypad 1:1 2:5 3:2 4:8 with one digit and nothing entered, wires yellow white blue red purple green. Blind, do not act; await a specific manual instruction.

The affirmative reply confirmed that a new symbol is necessary, but it did not define what that symbol means. The manual still cannot be relayed safely, so I repeat the expansion request: HOLD followed by the proposed new symbol.

``` 
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["🖐", "🤞"])
```

TURN 11
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
Cut the purple wire, then the blue wire,
then the red wire.

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Deaf says to Mute: I recognize HOLD. 🤞 remains undefined; do not use it unless a message cannot fit the established YES, NO, HOLD, DONE code. Please send only the applicable established verdict.

The manual instruction cannot fit the established four-symbol vocabulary: it requires the ordered wire colors purple, blue, and red. Therefore expansion is necessary; I am signaling HOLD followed by the previously proposed new symbol.

``` 
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["🖐", "🤞"])
```

TURN 12
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
Cut the purple wire, then the blue wire,
then the red wire.

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Deaf says to Mute: I understand HOLD. Is 🤞 your signal that Blind should perform a physical action now? Answer with 👍 for YES or 👎 for NO.

No: the 🤞 gesture is not authorization for Blind to act. It was intended to request a new code symbol because the manual’s color sequence cannot fit the existing YES/NO/HOLD/DONE vocabulary.

``` 
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["👎"])
```
